description: Commercial overlay district mapped within higher-density Residence Districts (typically R6-R10). Allows moderate-density commercial uses. Residential equivalent varies by underlying district.

bulk.residential_equivalent: R5 to R6 depending on map location
bulk.max_commercial_far: Varies per underlying district — up to 2.0 in some, higher in others
bulk.far_note: Mixed buildings: commercial FAR + residential FAR (each limited separately). Total may exceed single-use FAR. Per §35-33: total of all FARs shall not exceed greatest single-use FAR — this limits combined FAR to the higher of the two, not both.

height_setback.regulation_type: Per §35-62 (R1-R5 equivalent) or §35-63 (R6-R12 equivalent) depending on residential equivalent
height_setback.notes: Verify whether C1-5 overlay is in R1-R5 or R6-R12 equivalent area. Height/setback follow the applicable section accordingly.
height_setback.building_height_note: Commercial portion per §33-43; residential per §23-42 or §23-43

residential: Residential permitted above commercial in mixed building

dob_filing_notes: Identify underlying residential equivalent on zoning map — determines FAR and height
Check if in R6-R12 area: §35-63 applies; R1-R5: §35-62 applies
Mixed buildings: verify total FAR does not exceed greatest single-use FAR per §35-33(d)
Conversions: existing pre-1961 buildings exempt from FAR limits per §35-31
DOB: mixed-use analysis required for commercial and residential separately
